drone.name: maintenance drone
drone.description: A squat machine on three wheels, with a single camera eye and a tool arm folded against its side.
drone.initial: The maintenance drone idles here, its eye light pulsing.
drone.talk: The drone turns its eye towards you. "Ready for queries," it says.
drone.noTopic: The drone's eye light flickers. "Query not recognised."

topics.text: "Main power coupling failed during the debris strike," the drone says. "A spare is held in stores."
"The stores code is recorded in the maintenance log," the drone says. "The log is in the galley."
"Dish alignment nominal. The beacon can be sent from the control room."
"Dish alignment fault," the drone says. "Manual correction requires a walk outside. Suit air is limited."
"Supply tender Wren," the drone says. "It cannot dock without the beacon."
"Your suit holds air for a short job only," the drone says. "Do not dawdle on the hull."
"The shaft and reactor bay are unlit without main power," the drone says. "You keep a torch in your locker."
